title: Browns QB Deshaun Watson laments ‘disrespectful’ booing by team’s own fans

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Browns QB Deshaun Watson laments ‘disrespectful’ booing by team’s own fans
sources.description: Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson has called the booing he heard from the team’s own fans during Saturday’s home loss to Buffalo “disrespectful” and “personal.” Watson, who has a complicated relationship with Cleveland fans because of injuries, off-field issues – including an NFL suspension in 2022 – and a massive, $230m contract, was booed repeatedly during the second half of the 31-7 loss to the Bills. Browns head coach Todd Monken has yet to decide which QB will start the season opener in Jacksonville on 13 September.
